description: Change of use from betting shop to fitness gym
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (A100, A200, A400, A500, design and access statement- received 05/06/220 
A001, A002 and site investigation and noise breakout assessment- received 22/06/20
cover letter- received 21/07/20 9 Round Vibration Mitigation plan- 08/09/20) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used for fitness studio and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class E (d)  of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 4 - The use of the building within Use Class E (d) shall not be open to customers outside of the following hours: 05:30 - 10:00pm Monday to Saturday; 05:30 - 10:00pm, Sundays and Bank Holidays.

Condition : 5 - PPrior to use of the hereby approved fitness studio, the sound-limiting device to mitigate noise from amplified music shall be installed with sealable and non-tamper proof. The noise levels shall be agreed by an Environmental Health Officer from the Neighbourhood Enforcement Team (the music noise level could be subject to change if required by the Neighbourhood Enforcement Team).

Condition : 6 - Before the use hereby permitted is first commenced, the recommendations made in all parts of Section 7 of approved document 'Site Investigation and Noise Breakout Assessment' shall be implemented.
